business_summary: Tikona Communication Limited provides telecommunications and digital infrastructure services across India. The company offers infrastructure solutions, such as tower infrastructure, FTTH infrastructure, smart systems, and enterprise solutions. It operates fiber optic network infrastructure and provides fiber leasing services, including route monitoring, preventive maintenance, fault restoration, and operations and maintenance. It provides smart systems for residential, commercial, and industrial spaces for managing energy use, enhancing security, and automating homes and offices. Its home and building automation products include smart prepaid meters, video door phones, intercom systems, and smart home automation. Its security and access solutions include CCTV surveillance, fire alarm systems, access control, boom barrier, and parking management systems. The company serves residential users, small and medium businesses, and large enterprises across multiple Indian cities. Tikona Communication Limited was formerly known as Grand Foundry Limited and changed its name to Tikona Communication Limited in September 2026. Tikona Communication Limited was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Noida, India. Tikona Communication Limited operates as a subsidiary of SAR Televenture Limited. As of September 28, 2026, Tikona Communication Limited operates as a subsidiary of SAR Televenture Limited.
